newsitem.title: USA: Datascope reaches settlement on lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Datascope reaches settlement on lawsuit.

text.p: Datascope Corp said Monday it has reached an oral agreement in principle to settle a shareholder class action securities lawsuit, resulting in an after-tax charge of $3.3 million, or $0.20 per share.
The charge is to be taken in the first quarter ended September 30, the company said.
The company said that although it believes the allegations are without merit, it chose to settle the lawsuit to avoid prolonged and expensive litigation. The lawsuit dates back to November 1993.
The lawsuit alleged the company gave the wrong impression on how quickly its product, VasoSeal, would be introduced.
The settlement is subject to final documentation and court approval. There are no assurances it will be finalized.
Datascope manufactures proprietary products for clinical health care markets.
